baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose clause built on ظ ه ر and extending over الدين كله.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus verb holds disclosure and superiority together, while دين supplies an order of obedience and كل supplies exhaustive scope. The result is not forced to choose between becoming unmistakably visible and becoming ascendant.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from concealment supplies the disclosure pole: the true order is brought into public intelligibility.
Rising over and prevailing supplies the superiority pole without erasing the simultaneous visibility sense.
Obedience and practiced allegiance make the compared field a set of governing orders, not labels alone.
The gathering of every part into a whole gives the claim its deliberately unabridged horizon.

changed_reading.before: The true religion will simply defeat all other religions.
changed_reading.after: The true order is to become wholly exposed as such and to rise over every order of allegiance; manifestation and supremacy remain coexisting senses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أرسل رسوله بالهدى ودين الحق ... وكفى بالله شهيدا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A carrier is dispatched with gentle direction; truth is made evident, and the closing witness supplies knowledgeable attestation. The mission therefore has an evidentiary mechanism as well as an expansionary one.

activation_trace.role: A messenger as bearer of carried speech makes transmission, rather than bare force, the initiating mechanism.
Gentle indication toward a path or truth specifies what the bearer transports and how it directs.
Establishing truth by making its evidence apparent links truth directly to the purpose of manifestation.
Knowledgeable declaration closes the mechanism as attestation, not merely as an ornamental divine epithet.
Completing an undertaking until it is sufficient makes divine attestation adequate to the mission's truth claim.

changed_reading.before: The messenger brings a doctrine whose success is later certified by God.
changed_reading.after: The sent carrier bears a gently directing truth whose very manifestation is evidentiary, with divine knowledge completing its attestation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compressed pairing دين الحق and the final witness formula.
baseline_models.mechanism: The account, debt, obligation, proprietary claim, and witness branches assemble a juridical-economic reading: this دين is what is due and what justly adjudicates rival liabilities and loyalties.

activation_trace.role: Accounting, judgment, and recompense turn دين into a governing calculus of what actions incur.
Debt and deferred obligation add the concrete image of a claim that remains outstanding until discharged.
Fixed entitlement and binding necessity characterize the account as genuinely due rather than conventionally asserted.
A right possessed by its claimant makes truth a just claim with relational obligations.
Presence at an event gives the juridical account a competent witness rather than an abstract endorsement.

changed_reading.before: دين الحق means only the religion that possesses correct propositions.
changed_reading.after: It can also mean the binding and just account: a due claim before which every rival calculus of allegiance is exposed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repetition of دين on both sides of على.
baseline_models.mechanism: The habitual-state branch broadens the comparison beyond named creeds. The truth-order is set over every entrenched way, customary regime, and repeated social pattern that functions as obedience.

activation_trace.role: Habitual condition and accustomed practice expand religion into the patterned order by which life is actually run.
Ascendance now operates over embedded practices and institutions, not only over verbal confessions.
Total enclosure prevents the target field from shrinking to a few formally named communities.

changed_reading.before: The comparison concerns a finite list of religions.
changed_reading.after: The comparison may include every habitual order that organizes allegiance, conduct, judgment, and social life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وكفى بالله شهيدا, especially the split mapping supplied for ك ف ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant sufficiency branch says the witness completes what is needed; the supplied ك ف ف mapping adds withholding. Together they tentatively make divine sufficiency a limit on an unlimited human proof or enforcement project.

activation_trace.role: Adequately carrying an undertaking to completion supplies the primary sense that God's witness meets the need.
The non-dominant withholding branch introduces a possible limiting function: sufficiency can stop excess action.
Decisive declaration supplies the proof that is complete without requiring universal human corroboration.

changed_reading.before: God is merely an additional witness to an outcome humans must establish without limit.
changed_reading.after: God's witness may both complete the proof and restrain the human demand to force or endlessly certify that proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first names its decisive event through opening and clarification. Those branches make the disclosure pole of يظهر operational: victory opens a closed field and makes what was occluded distinguishable.

activation_trace.role: An obstruction opening into a widened entrance supplies the event-form through which manifestation can occur.
Becoming apparent after separation makes the opening explicitly revelatory rather than only territorial.
Clarification by speech or sign gives the victory an intelligible, communicative surface.
The focus emergence branch receives the earlier opening as its concrete contextual mechanism.

structural_cues: The opening ayah predicates the event with a doubled opening root and then qualifies it as manifest or clarifying.
The focus purpose clause later reuses a root whose branch inventory also joins appearance to outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening plus clarification and later disclosure plus superiority; I infer that the opening is one mechanism of manifestation, while a primarily military opening remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Prevailing is chiefly the displacement of rivals.
changed_reading.after: Prevailing begins by opening what was closed and rendering the true order publicly distinguishable; displacement remains possible but is not the only mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier commission explicitly sends the addressee as a witness; the focus sends the messenger with guidance and closes with God as sufficient witness. This forms a relay of attestation with a divine terminus.

activation_trace.role: The dispatched carrier role is explicitly joined to witnessing, establishing testimony as part of the mission itself.
Knowledgeable declaration names the messenger's contextual office and supplies the first link in the attestive relay.
The same carrier branch identifies the focus messenger as the commissioned bearer rather than a self-authorizing victor.
Divine declaration closes and underwrites the messenger's witness even before every audience assents.

structural_cues: 48:8 has the compact sequence sending then witness; 48:28 repeats sending and places sufficient witness at the end.
The two commissions frame the intervening surah as evidence carried by the messenger's mission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two mirrored sending-witness configurations; I infer a commissioned witness underwritten by an ultimate witness, while coordination rather than hierarchy between the two witnesses remains possible.

changed_reading.before: God's witness is a closing endorsement added after the messenger's task.
changed_reading.after: Witness-bearing is internal to the sent mission, and God's sufficient witness gives that testimony standing independent of universal recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge scene turns allegiance into a transaction-like covenant that can be broken or fulfilled. It activates the account, debt, entitlement, and witness branches in the focus as enacted relations rather than remote metaphors.

activation_trace.role: A pledge of obedience gives the focus دين a concrete covenantal transaction and a transfer of allegiance.
Undoing a firmly made covenant supplies the default event whose liability falls back on the breaker.
Completion without deficiency supplies the opposite outcome: the obligation is fully discharged.
A preserved compact protected by trust makes the social bond durable and answerable.
Accounting and recompense receive an enacted covenant whose fulfillment or breach can be judged.
A fixed obligation characterizes the pledged order as due and binding, not merely preferred.

structural_cues: The pledge is syntactically transferred from pledging the messenger to pledging God.
Breach harms the breacher, whereas fulfillment receives recompense, giving the covenant an explicit account structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pledge, breach, fulfillment, and recompense; I infer that these enact the focus's account and obligation branches, while a purely political oath remains a narrower alternative.

changed_reading.before: The religion of truth is chiefly a body of correct teaching.
changed_reading.after: It is also a pledged order of due allegiance whose obligations, breaches, and fulfillment become openly adjudicable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context explicitly separates what tongues say from what hearts contain. That contrast prevents manifestation from collapsing into public profession: true ظهور must disclose or transform the inner core as well as produce outward speech.

activation_trace.role: The speaking organ supplies an outward verbal surface that can claim more than the speaker inwardly holds.
The heart supplies the concealed interior against which the truth of the public utterance is tested.
The inner core sharpens the contrast from two body parts into surface speech versus the essential center.
Disclosure now has to expose genuine allegiance rather than count a merely visible declaration as success.
The supplied heart-and-unseen branch lets the focus verb reach remembered or concealed interiority, not only exterior display.

structural_cues: 48:11 makes the mismatch explicit with a negated relation between tongue speech and heart content.
The focus asks for comprehensive manifestation, creating pressure against an exterior-only metric.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit surface-interior mismatch; I infer that it calibrates what counts as manifestation, while it could alternatively remain only a diagnosis of the laggards in 48:11.

changed_reading.before: Public profession or visible institutional success adequately realizes manifestation.
changed_reading.after: A manifestation of the true order must make outward speech answerable to the heart's actual allegiance; a verbal facade is counter-evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: A contextual alternative of fighting or yielding gives the superiority branch a concrete political-martial realization. This model remains live rather than being dissolved into visibility or inward transformation.

activation_trace.role: Mutual combat supplies an explicit coercive arena in which opposed allegiances can be contested.
Handing over or relinquishing supplies the noncombat endpoint of submission in the stated alternative.
Superiority over an opponent receives a direct contextual arena and cannot be reduced to private conviction.
Rule and subjection make political dominance one available, though not exhaustive, sense of the focus claim.

structural_cues: 48:16 coordinates combat and yielding as alternative outcomes and then contrasts obedience with turning away.
This occurs before the later scenes where force is deliberately withheld.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies combat and yielding; I infer a martial realization of focus superiority, while peaceful entry into safety or religious submission remains a live alternative for the yielding term.

changed_reading.before: Superiority is only epistemic visibility or moral influence.
changed_reading.after: One coexisting realization is concrete political-martial ascendancy in which opposition fights, yields, or transfers allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet twice makes withheld hands a divine sign and then explains that unrecognized believers could have been trampled unless populations were distinguished. This activates the split restraint branch inside focus كفى and constrains universal supremacy by discriminating protection.

activation_trace.role: Active withholding of others' force is made a sign, so restraint itself becomes evidence of guidance and capacity.
Mutual force is withheld after victory becomes possible, making nonexercise of power part of the victory mechanism.
Literal hands identify both parties' embodied agency as the object of reciprocal restraint.
Crushing pressure supplies the unrealized harm that indiscriminate advance would have inflicted on hidden believers.
Separation and discrimination supply the missing condition under which punitive force could avoid concealed innocents.
The focus split mapping now receives repeated contextual confirmation: sufficient divine witness can function through withholding.
Superiority remains live, but its exercise is limited by the packet's own protection and discrimination mechanism.
The total horizon is prevented from becoming indiscriminate treatment of every person within that horizon.

structural_cues: 48:20 calls withheld hands a sign and immediately joins it to guidance on a straight path.
48:24 places withholding after granted victory, and 48:25 supplies the hidden-person counterfactual that explains restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withheld force after advantage and a risk to unrecognized believers; I infer that these constrain the means of universal manifestation, while a local tactical delay rather than a general constraint remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Universal superiority naturally implies maximizing available coercive power.
changed_reading.after: Divine sufficiency can manifest precisely by withholding available force, distinguishing hidden persons, and delaying victory rather than trampling the field it claims to order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context opposes heated group zeal to tranquility, then binds the believers to a protective word and calls them more entitled and fitted to it. دين الحق becomes disciplined adherence to a rightful word, not mere possession of a triumphant identity.

activation_trace.role: Binding something by judgment makes the word an adhered-to discipline rather than a passing utterance.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the articulated norm to which the community is bound.
Protection from harm gives the bound word a restraining and preservative purpose against heated excess.
Entitlement and fitness identify who is properly answerable to the word, activating truth as due obligation.
Practiced obedience converts the bound word into a lived order rather than an identity claim.
The focus obligation branch receives a contextual model of rightful adherence opposed to zealotry.

structural_cues: 48:26 contrasts the heat of ignorance with descended tranquility before introducing the binding word.
The same ayah joins entitlement to being the word's proper people and ends with comprehensive divine knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies zealotry, tranquility, binding, protection, and entitlement; I infer that these specify the ethical texture of دين الحق, while the word could alternatively be one obligation within a broader order.

changed_reading.before: Truth-order prevails because its adherents possess the winning group identity.
changed_reading.after: Truth-order appears in being quietly bound to a protective, intelligible word for which its people prove fitting, against the heat of identity zeal.

context_deltas.mechanism: A dream is declared truthfully fulfilled, yet a nearer opening precedes the promised entry. The sequence makes divine witnessing temporal and testable: partial openings can attest a larger manifestation before its horizon is complete.

activation_trace.role: Fulfilling a promise in action converts a prior representation into publicly checkable event.
The dream supplies a concealed anticipatory image whose later realization can function as evidence.
Correspondence with what proves real gives the vision's fulfillment the quality of truth rather than coincidence.
A beginning that opens what follows supplies an intermediate realization without exhausting the promised endpoint.
A sign that attests a condition lets the nearer event witness to a larger still-unfolding purpose.
Manifestation becomes staged emergence whose first visible instances can verify the promised whole.

structural_cues: 48:27 distinguishes the promised secure entry from another, nearer opening placed before it.
The focus follows immediately with the larger purpose and a sufficiency-of-witness closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fulfilled vision, an intermediate opening, and then the universal purpose; I infer staged evidentiary fulfillment, while the nearer opening could be only a separate benefit rather than a pledge of the larger outcome.

changed_reading.before: The universal manifestation is an all-at-once future result that lacks evidence until complete.
changed_reading.after: It can unfold through partial, fulfilled signs whose correspondence to prior promise already witnesses the direction of the larger process.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final plant analogy supplies an explicit causal sequence: seed growth, emergence from hiding, lateral shoots, mutual support, thickening, and stable uprightness. Read back into the focus, sending initiates a distributed growth process whose visibility and ascendancy arise internally through supported multiplication.

activation_trace.role: An expressly posed analogy authorizes the plant sequence as a model rather than an accidental lexical cluster.
Germination and cultivation supply a temporally extended mode of increase rather than an instantaneous takeover.
Bringing what was hidden outward directly materializes the disclosure sense of focus manifestation.
New shoots around an origin turn expansion into plural growth that remains related to its source.
Plant parts strengthening one another supplies mutual support as the arrow from fragile emergence to durability.
Thickness after thinness marks accumulated strength without importing harsh conduct from another branch.
Rising into stable position supplies the mature plant's achieved upright visibility.
Load-bearing stems provide the material support on which the now-visible growth stands.
Dispatch and release become the initiating act that lets the growth process move beyond its source.
Emergence from concealment names the same transition that the shoot sequence renders materially.
Height and prevailing remain present as the mature result of growth rather than only an externally imposed relation.

structural_cues: 48:29 immediately follows the focus and gives a tightly ordered verbal chain from emergence to upright stability.
The analogy describes a plural community arising around an origin, not a solitary object merely enlarged from outside.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit plant sequence for the messenger's companions; I infer that it also models how the preceding purpose becomes visible and strong, while the analogy may alternatively describe only community formation and not الدين itself.

changed_reading.before: The true order becomes dominant mainly through top-down displacement of competitors.
changed_reading.after: Its manifestation can be organic and distributed: sending releases a growth that emerges, branches, mutually supports itself, thickens, and finally stands visibly strong.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible marks on faces caused by prostration turn the focus's manifestation and witness language into embodied evidence. The true order is recognizable in durable effects on persons, not only in territorial reach or verbal proclamation.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies an inspectable sign by which an inward practice becomes publicly known.
The second supplied mapping independently retains recognition by a sign, so the activation does not collapse the split root.
The face standing for the person locates the sign on publicly encountered identity rather than on an abstract institution.
A lasting trace indicating what occurred supplies the causal residue by which devotion bears witness.
An attesting sign connects the visible trace to the focus's closing witness rather than treating it as decoration.
Public appearance becomes the embodied legibility of practiced allegiance.

structural_cues: The sign is grammatically located on faces and causally related to an effect of prostration.
This embodied sign precedes the plant analogy, joining personal trace to collective growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible personal marks caused by worship; I infer that these instantiate the focus's manifestation and witness, while the marks may alternatively be one local description rather than a general mode of prevalence.

changed_reading.before: Manifestation is measured mainly by public institutions, territory, or explicit proclamation.
changed_reading.after: The true order also manifests as durable, recognizable effects of practice borne by persons who become signs witnessing to it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ordinary guidance is not a sacrificial animal, but the packet gives the focus root an offering-to-the-sanctuary branch and places an explicit blocked offering nearby with the same root and an unrealized destination. It remains anchored to بالهدى and should be rendered only as a processional or entrusted-gift resonance, never as a replacement for guidance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بالهدى at 48:28, activated by the nearby الهدي that is prevented from reaching its appointed place.

activation_trace.role: The focus root's consecrated-offering branch lets guidance carry a contained resonance of something entrusted and borne toward a sacred destination.
The nearby literal offering activates the same branch and supplies temporary obstruction without cancellation of purpose.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the delayed destination structure that turns obstruction into deferred reaching.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is only information or route-direction carried by the messenger.
changed_reading.after: Guidance may additionally resonate as an entrusted offering carried toward manifestation: it can be obstructed en route without losing its consecrated destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ه د د mapping for the focus root. It remains packet-valid and gains a contextual bridge from the opening of what was closed, but downstream prose must label it as a split-root acoustic-structural activation, not a lexical gloss of الهدى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The supplied split mapping for ه د ي at بالهدى, linked back to the focus purpose of bringing truth out.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking or demolition supplies the strange possibility that guidance disrupts hardened enclosures before truth can emerge.
A closed barrier opening into access provides the contextual bridge from disruptive breaking to a productive aperture.
Emergence from concealment supplies the focus-anchored result and keeps breaking subordinate to disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Guidance operates only by gentle indication within already open structures.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root activation, guidance may also break a hardened enclosure so that the true order can come into view.

strongest_changes: The opening vocabulary makes victory a disclosure event as well as superiority.
The pledge scene turns دين الحق into a due covenant whose breach and fulfillment are judged.
Repeatedly withheld hands and protected hidden believers constrain supremacy by restraint and discrimination.
The final plant sequence recasts manifestation as distributed emergence, mutual support, thickening, and stable growth.
summary.what_was_special: The focus held several mechanisms at once instead of resolving them: attested transmission, juridical obligation, martial ascendancy, restrained power, inward-outward verification, staged fulfillment, embodied signs, and organic growth. The nearby blocked offering also activated a surprising but anchored processional resonance in guidance.
remaining_uncertainties: The relative weight of disclosure and dominance in يظهر remains intentionally unresolved.
The martial submission scene and the later withheld-hands scenes support different calibrations of how superiority is enacted.
The 48:29 plant analogy may model the preceding purpose itself or only the community produced by that purpose.
The offering and ه د د split-root readings are live exploratory resonances, not lexical replacements for guidance.
